question: Should the Agent runtime bridge proceed as the next Station phase for one SSH-backed provider, without model credential delivery?
rationale: The repository has accepted the contract but intentionally deferred runtime wiring until maintainers choose Station readiness, the first provider, and the initial credential posture.

options.title: Approve narrow bridge phase
options.body: Implement the documented bridge for one SSH-backed provider with pinned artifacts, loopback access, scoped tickets, lifecycle evidence, and no model credentials.

options.title: Wait for generic Station
options.body: Keep this use case open but begin implementation only after https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/193 ships stable Station lifecycle commands and evidence.

options.title: Include modelAccess immediately
options.body: Design bridge and scoped model credential delivery together, accepting a substantially larger security and product-review surface.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow bridge phase
recommendation.body: Implement the documented bridge for one SSH-backed provider with pinned artifacts, loopback access, scoped tickets, lifecycle evidence, and no model credentials.

likelyOwner.reason: The current contract language and phase boundary trace most directly to their authored mainline work.
